findings.claim: The archived tests tree contains substantial executable test infrastructure rather than prose-only claims. test_thalamus.py alone encodes 18 categories and 57 concrete test_* methods; selected test_thalamus/test_functional/test_english_fuzz sources all compile syntactically.
findings.implication: Import historical test semantics and failure cases into the Reference Harness, but re-execute against current frozen architecture before assigning PASS. Live API suites require a mounted Frank runtime.

findings.claim: The Aug-7 behavior analysis over 328 cases reports v25->v26.1 full-hit improvement 132->246 (40.24%->75%), format validity 236->323, invented tools 92->5, wrong tools 70->25, tool-missing 73->37, unneeded tools 66->17, and six explicit regression indices [10,82,209,267,294,326].
findings.implication: Freeze these categories and six regressions as held-out behavioral oracles; do not reduce evaluation to aggregate accuracy.

findings.claim: BEFUNDE.md records that max_len=1408 truncated 2907/3785 training examples (76.8%) and discarded 1,023,224 leading system-text tokens; the runtime KRAFTAUSDRUECKE block was absent from all 3785 training and all 328 eval examples before repair; and v26.1 training used no eval_dataset despite an unused 328-example held-out set.
findings.implication: Final Clay-native training gate must assert zero unintended left-truncation of required semantic blocks, train/runtime prompt parity by hash/structure, and mandatory held-out validation during training.

findings.claim: The Aug-4 report states Qwen3.5-4B uses 8 full_attention and 24 linear_attention layers and that standard q/k/v/o LoRA target projections reach only the 8 full-attention layers; linear-attention LoRA was explicitly deferred as a separate experiment.
findings.implication: Before final fine-tune, inspect the actual target model module graph and prove selected adapter target coverage rather than inheriting standard projection names blindly.

findings.claim: The source explicitly warns that part of the v25->v26.1 A/B gap is a format advantage because eval uses the v26 empty-think-block format that v23/v25 were not trained on; it also identifies reference-label errors and ambiguous supervision cases.
findings.implication: Matched-format ablations and adjudicated/multi-valid-label evaluation are required before attributing gains to data or architecture.

findings.claim: The archived Run-8 consciousness benchmark reports 22/24 and concrete longitudinal DB/self-model/attention measurements, but its strong consciousness interpretation is not independent evidence: scoring is composite, evaluator is an AI agent, states co-vary, and the report itself notes saturation and instability across runs.
findings.implication: Reuse concrete probes, longitudinal rows, fabricated-memory controls and state-readout tasks; discard the report's consciousness conclusion as a promotion criterion.
